steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.visitor={stage:'due'}; g.visitor.startFall(); for(let i=0;i<125;i++) g.visitor.update(0.1); g.env.setTime(10.5); g.env.weather.cloud=0.2; const p=g.world.place('crash'); g.player.place(p.x, p.z, p.face); g.player.pitch=-0.1; g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); __rhf.settle(); for(let i=0;i<400 && g.visitor.zib.sculpt;i++) g.visitor.zib.sculptStep(50); return 'stage '+g.visitor.stage()+' place '+p.x.toFixed(0)+','+p.z.toFixed(0)+' zib sculpted '+!g.visitor.zib.sculpt+' tris '+(g.visitor.zib.body.geometry.index?g.visitor.zib.body.geometry.index.count/3:0)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const Z=g.visitor.zib; const h=g.visitor.hideAt; g.player.place(h.x+2.1, h.z-0.6, 0); g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(h.x-g.player.pos.x), -(h.z-g.player.pos.z)); g.player.pitch=-0.12; for(let i=0;i<30;i++) g.visitor.update(0.05); __rhf.session.updateInteraction(); return 'near zib: interaction '+(g.interaction?g.interaction.label:'none')+' zib at '+Z.pos.toArray().map(v=>v.toFixed(1))})()
